units.source_text: 南来和尚斩猫，是斩断自我的迷妄，斩断妄念妄想的根源。

en.t: When Master Nanlai cut down the cat, it meant cutting off the delusions of the self and severing the root of false thoughts and fantasies.

units.source_text: 通过无情的实践，把猫首新掉，以此寓意斩断一切矛盾、对立、自己和他人的争执。

en.t: Through this ruthless act of practice, by cutting off the cat's head, he symbolized the severing of all contradictions, oppositions, and disputes between oneself and others.

units.source_text: 如果把这个叫做"杀人刀"，那赵州的作为就是"活人剑"。

en.t: If this is called the "sword that kills," then Zhaozhou's action was the "sword that gives life."

units.source_text: 他将沾满泥泞的被人蔑视的草鞋项在头上，以这种无限的宽容实践了菩萨之道。

en.t: He placed on his head the mud-soaked straw sandals that people despised, and through this boundless tolerance he practiced the way of the bodhisattva.
